description: This file defines React components for rendering a context menu related to file operations in a web application's user interface. It includes components for displaying a menu with file options, managed through various controllers, and handles user interactions such as opening and closing the menu.

methods.name: FileContextMenu
methods.description: A React functional component that renders a popover containing file menu options, controlled by props and state managed via controllers.

methods.name: FileContextMenuWrapper
methods.description: A wrapper component that conditionally renders the FileContextMenu component based on the current UI state.
